summary.name: Giiso写作机器人
summary.one_liner: Giiso Writing Robot is a Chinese AI writing assistant for content creation, covering news articles, Xiaohongshu copy, short-video scripts, PPT slides, and AI image generation.
use_cases: writing news articles from trending topics
proofreading Chinese text for typos and homophone errors
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a set of writing modes: general writing, news writing (using eight trending-topic lists), article rewriting that preserves meaning, Xiaohongshu copy, copy style conversion, PPT creation with automatic layout, and proofreading for grammar, word, and homophone errors. It also lists AI text-to-image generation and AI article illustration. The meta description additionally mentions short-video scripts, sensitive-word detection, material recommendation, plagiarism checking, and error correction. The company, founded in Shenzhen in 2013, now promotes an enterprise AI agent ecosystem for finance, e-commerce, healthcare, education, and government.
notable: Trending-topic news writing using eight hot-list rankings
Xiaohongshu copy and copy style conversion
Sensitive-word detection and plagiarism checking for self-media writers
caveats: Page does not state pricing; a recharge center is mentioned but no plans are listed
Interface is in Chinese, so the tool targets Chinese-language writing
